new_findings.finding: deduplicate merges incoming normalization_warnings only from the first record per (source, provider_response_id) key: warnings carried by a later-position duplicate are silently dropped, while the same record placed first retains them (order asymmetry). README states 'all distinct raw snapshots and warnings are retained', which does not hold for re-merging prior reconciliation outputs. Snapshots, counters, cost and attribution are unaffected; the loss is informational only and nothing is corrupted or double-charged.
new_findings.reproduction: cd /tmp/opencode/glm-usage-review && python3 -B diagnostics/usage-cross-review-diagnostic.py -> exit 1 with exactly one failing check 'incoming warnings from later duplicate preserved?'; or run the inline minimal repro in checks[7] which prints 'prior_pass_warning retained: False'.
new_findings.repair: Union row['normalization_warnings'] into previous['normalization_warnings'] (alongside the erasure warnings) before the existing sorted(set(...)) step, so retention is order-independent. Snapshot union already behaves this way.

new_findings.finding: Exception-type contract escapes on pathological inputs, all failing loudly (no silent corruption): normalize({'cost': 10**400}) raises OverflowError ('int too large to convert to float') from math.isfinite before the intended ValueError; deduplicate on structurally malformed records (missing 'run_id' or 'billing_counters' keys; non-JSON-serializable identity fields) raises KeyError/TypeError instead of ReconciliationError. Lone-surrogate run_id raises UnicodeEncodeError, which is a ValueError subclass and therefore stays within the documented contract.
new_findings.reproduction: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'inputs/harness'); from normalize_usage import normalize; normalize({'cost':10**400}, run_id='r', session_id='s', actor_role='coordinator', requested_model='z-ai/glm-5.3-flash', response_id='x', mapping_id='glm-relace-completion-only-r7', provider_tag='relace/fp4', phase='cross_review')" -> OverflowError.
new_findings.repair: Clamp or pre-check int cost magnitude (or convert via try/except OverflowError to ValueError); in deduplicate, validate required record structure and identity-field JSON-serializability first and raise ReconciliationError/ValueError with the raw record retained.
